import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_7/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_7/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'city' as per operation history
df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Ensure columns have correct types matching target schema:
# Target schema: ['city': string, 'driver_count': int, 'type': string, 'date': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': int]

# Convert driver_count to int (source likely int already)
df['driver_count'] = df['driver_count'].astype(int)

# 'type' and 'city' are strings, ensure string type
df['type'] = df['type'].astype(str)
df['city'] = df['city'].astype(str)

# 'date' as string (keep as is)
df['date'] = df['date'].astype(str)

# 'fare' as float
df['fare'] = df['fare'].astype(float)

# 'ride_id' as int (ride_id looks very large, so use int64)
df['ride_id'] = df['ride_id'].astype('int64')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df = df[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']]

# Write to target CSV without index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_7/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_7/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_7/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city column (inner join)
result = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Ensure column order and types match target schema exactly

# Convert ride_id to integer if not already
result["ride_id"] = result["ride_id"].astype(int)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_7/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
